extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Orange County has a $25 monthly premium, a $315 drug deductible and a $6600 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before the disclaimer, which is non-compliant. The agent collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled a plan review, both of which were compliant.
composition.coaching_note: Luis, it's important to deliver the disclaimer before discussing any benefits to ensure compliance. In this call, the disclaimer was given after the benefits discussion, which is a violation. Next time, make sure to deliver the disclaimer first, followed by the benefits discussion.

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign Scope of Appointment, schedule plan review
